title: The Real Problem
text: Tell you whether a model drifts off track after 50 steps. That's the real problem a harness exists to solve.

title: The Real Computer Analogy
text: Method, think of it like a computer. The model is the CPU, raw processing power. The context window is the RAM, limited volatile working memory. The agent harness is the operating system. title: Harness vs. Framework vs. SDK
text: Real different things. A framework gives you building blocks to assemble an agent's logic. An SDK is a vendor's library for calling one specific model's features.
